articles.title: US hits three Iranian oil tankers after saying its warships were targeted
articles.description: Iran's state media reported that Tehran has launched retaliatory attacks against three US-affiliated vessels; the US is yet to comment.

articles.title: At least two dead in blast at Bolivia military barracks
articles.description: Authorities fear the death toll in Viacha will rise and warn people to stay away from the barracks due to a risk of further explosions.

articles.title: Russia hits Ukrainian security headquarters in drone attack, Zelensky says
articles.description: The unmanned aerial vehicle struck without warning in the heart of the Ukrainian capital.

articles.title: Two pilots die in Greek military jet crash
articles.description: Two pilots have died after a Greek military jet crashed during an air show.

articles.title: Explosion kills at least two at military base in Bolivia with 14 missing
articles.description: At least two people have been killed with 14 missing after an explosion at a military barracks in Bolivia, officials said.
